snippet.description:
.Buster Bros. - CAPCOM.

.
.Wiki. - "Buster Bros. Collection is a compilation of Buster Bros., Super Buster Bros., and Buster Buddies.The graphics and sound are the same as the arcade versions, but the music is emulated by Portable Sound Format (PSF) files, which are very similar to MIDI."
